content.text:
You are checking a netlist that an automatic computer-vision pipeline extracted from an analog circuit schematic. Your job is to find and fix its mistakes.

You are given the original schematic image (710 x 505 pixels). It is the ground truth -
trust it over everything else. The pipeline's results are given as text below. Positions are
pixel coordinates in that image: x from the left edge, y from the top edge.

Pipeline netlist. For each component: ID, type, bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1], then each pin
as pin=net@(x, y), where (x, y) is the lead the pipeline attached that pin to.
GND and VDD come from ground / supply symbols; netK are the other nets; ncK means the pin was
left unconnected. Pins with the same net name are connected according to the pipeline.
  M1   PMOS      [545, 51, 600, 127]  Drain=net1@(596, 128), Gate=VDD@(542, 90), Source=VDD@(596, 48)
  M2   PMOS      [344, 52, 398, 127]  Drain=net2@(392, 128), Gate=VDD@(340, 90), Source=VDD@(372, 48)
  M3   PMOS      [185, 52, 240, 127]  Drain=net3@(190, 128), Gate=VDD@(242, 90), Source=VDD@(190, 48)
  A1   Diso_amp  [231, 118, 354, 215]  InP=net3@(263, 216), InN=net2@(320, 216), Out=VDD@(292, 114)
  R1   Res       [174, 261, 208, 326]  Pos=net3@(190, 258), Neg=net4@(190, 328)
  R2   Res       [578, 304, 614, 371]  Pos=net1@(596, 300), Neg=GND@(596, 374)
  R3   Res       [70, 348, 107, 415]  Pos=net3@(89, 344), Neg=GND@(89, 418)
  R4   Res       [476, 348, 512, 415]  Pos=net2@(494, 345), Neg=GND@(494, 417)
  Q1   NPN       [184, 372, 225, 444]  Collector=net4@(190, 370), Base=net4@(228, 410), Emitter=GND@(190, 446)
  Q2   NPN       [358, 375, 398, 445]  Collector=net2@(392, 372), Base=net2@(356, 410), Emitter=GND@(393, 446)

Crossings (wire crossings the pipeline found, with their box and decision):
  (none detected)

Spots where the pipeline itself was unsure:
  - R1: 1 extra line(s) touch the box but were not assigned to any pin, at (211, 293).

Allowed component types and their pins:
  NMOS: Drain, Source, Gate, Body  (Body optional)
  PMOS: Drain, Source, Gate, Body  (Body optional)
  NPN: Base, Emitter, Collector
  PNP: Base, Emitter, Collector
  Res: Pos, Neg
  Cap: Pos, Neg
  Ind: Pos, Neg
  Diode: In, Out
  Voltage: Positive, Negative
  Current: In, Out
  Diso_amp: InN, InP, Out
  Siso_amp: In, Out
  Dido_amp: InN, InP, OutN, OutP

Typical pipeline errors to look for:
- a wire attached to the wrong pin, or a MOSFET drain and source swapped;
- two different nets merged (text, arrows or labels touching wires join them) or one net split;
- a crossing decided wrongly (dot = connected; hop arc = not connected);
- a wrong component type (NMOS/PMOS/NPN/PNP, single-ended vs fully differential amplifier),
  a missed component, or a detection that is not a component;
- op-amp + and - inputs swapped.

Rules:
- Most of the netlist is probably correct. Only edit what the image shows to be wrong.
- Net names do not matter, only which pins share a net. Do not rename nets.
- Ground and supply symbols are not components.
- If everything is correct, return an empty list.

Return ONLY a JSON object (no markdown fences) of the form
{"edits": [ ... ]}
where each edit is one of the following (you may add a short "why" field to any edit):
{"op": "set_pin", "component": "M3", "pin": "Drain", "net": "net5"}
    Connect one pin to a net. Use an existing net name, or a NEW name (e.g. "new1") to give
    the pin a net of its own / to split a net (give every pin that moves the same new name).
{"op": "swap_pins", "component": "M3", "pins": ["Drain", "Source"]}
    Exchange the nets of two pins of one component (e.g. drain/source, InP/InN, Pos/Neg).
{"op": "merge_nets", "nets": ["net2", "net7"]}
    The listed nets are one net (wires that are actually connected). The first name is kept.
{"op": "change_type", "component": "Q1", "type": "PNP", "pins": {"Collector": "net1", ...}}
    Wrong component type. "pins" is optional when the pins map one-to-one
    (NMOS/PMOS/NPN/PNP: Drain<->Collector, Gate<->Base, Source<->Emitter;
    Res/Cap/Ind; Diode/Current); otherwise give the full pin -> net mapping for the new type.
{"op": "add_component", "type": "Res", "pins": {"Pos": "net1", "Neg": "GND"}}
    A component the pipeline missed.
{"op": "remove_component", "component": "R4"}
    Not a real component (e.g. a detection on text or a symbol that is not a device).
{"op": "remove_pin", "component": "M2", "pin": "Body"}
    Only for the optional MOSFET Body pin.
